bases.label: AIGF Phase 1 tender design
bases.description: The 220,000-equivalent minimum planned design in the Phase 1 tender: four Lot 1 facilities at 25,000 plus three Lot 2 facilities at 40,000. A full-envelope proposal is conditionally 220,000/220,000 only if every relevant contract adopts the protocol. This is not installed or protected capacity, public-access hours, global compute or a common denominator for other policies. Observation 2026-10-31; stage: planned procurement envelope.
